source_evidence: Your broker may route your order -- especially a limit order -- to an electronic communications network (ECN) that automatically matches buy and sell orders at specified prices.
answer: An electronic communications network (ECN) is one place your broker may send an order for execution. An ECN automatically matches buy and sell orders at specified prices. Brokers may route orders to an ECN, especially limit orders; this is one possible execution route, not a guarantee of a particular execution price.
